title: Trono Qhepapi Llantuy
intro: Qanmi sayashanki huk atiyniyoq ñawpa reinoq patio ukhupi, chaypin huk atiyniyoq kamachikuq llapa runakunaq diosnin hina willakurqan. Kay kamachikuqpa ladonpin sayashan huk Dios sonqo kamachi, paymanmi encargakun reinoq aswan hatun munayninkunata. Kuskataqmi rimanakunku, planeanku ima, manataqmi uyariyta munankuchu pusananpaq kachasqa willakuqpa advertenciankunata. ¿Atiwaqchu reparayta pichus kay hunt’aq sirviente kasqanmanta?
clues: Ñuqaqa kawsarqanim huk atiyniyuq runapa kamachisqan hatun reinopi, paymi nirqa llapa runakunapa hawanpi dios kasqanmanta.
Kay kamachikuqpa confiasqan ministron hinan llank’arqani, tukuy ima munasqankutapas kamachikuyninkuta hunt’aspa.
Allahpa huk kachasqan allpaykuman hamuptin chiqap kaqman qayamuwaptinku, kamachiqniywan ñuqawan mana uyariyta munarqanikuchu.
Kamachiwarqankun hatun ninata rawrachinaypaq, t’urumanta ladrillokunata wakichinaypaq, hatun wasi ruwanapaq.
Kamachiqniyqa ancha altomanmi sayarichiyta munarqa, chaynapi kikin hanaq pachaman chayananpaq.
Tukuyninpiqa kamachikuqniypas, ejercitoykupas, unuwan apasqa, lamar-qochaq ukhunpin unupi chinkaykurqayku.

trial.label: Prueba/Evento nisqa
options: Rumimanta idolokunata yupaychaymanta huk llaqtata rikcharichispa
Killa rakiy, hanaq pacha señal hina

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Sumaq palaciopi mana imamanta manchakuspa hoqarisqa
Rey kaywan, hanaq pacha yachaywan hatunchasqa

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
